summary: I wrote one ticket: docs/features/societe/tickets/01-page-societe.md. It covers all three parts of the plan: lib/company.ts with its tests, the /admin/societe page (page.tsx, CompanyForm.tsx, actions.ts), and the 'Exercice' block on the dashboard. The parts are small, go through the same graph and fit in one implement session. Part 3 reuses getCompany() from part 1, which ships in the same ticket. The ticket has 16 acceptance criteria, each checkable by a test, plus the legacy behaviour it keeps and what it leaves out. The audit_log columns are user_id, action, entity, entity_id, details and created_at (from legacy/sql/01_schema.sql). The migration plan (docs/features/societe/migration-plan.md) had been committed to main, not to feat/societe, so I merged main into feat/societe (commit 2c0e102) to bring it onto the branch. Then I committed the ticket on its own (e019a7d) and pushed. There is no separate PRD: the migration plan is the only input.
